description: Four eight-step voltage sequencers sharing one quantizer, each with its own clock and output and all of them gathered onto a polyphonic output

params.text: When this is on, each clocked sequence adds its step voltage to the voltage the previous clocked sequence put out rather than standing alone; the first clocked sequence is unaffected
Switches C into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Switches C# into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Switches D into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Switches D# into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Switches E into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Switches F into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Switches F# into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Switches G into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Switches G# into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Switches A into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Switches A# into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Switches B into the set of notes every sequence is quantised to
Sets how many of the eight steps this sequence plays before it returns to the first, 1 to 8
Sets the voltage for this step, -1 to +1 multiplied by the range chosen on the menu

inputs.text: The clock for this sequence; the sequence runs only while a cable is patched here, and only a clocked sequence reaches the poly out
A rising edge here sends all four sequences back to their first step

outputs.text: One channel for each sequence that has a clock patched, carrying that sequence's output voltage
The voltage this sequence is putting out, quantised to the notes switched on

notes: a sequence does nothing until a clock is patched to its own clock input, and only clocked sequences appear at the poly out.
with no note buttons switched on the quantizer is bypassed and the step voltages are put out unrounded.
the quantizer splits each octave evenly between however many notes are switched on, so every one of them gets the same share of the incoming voltage rather than the share nearest to it.
the note display reads out the note a step knob has landed on while you turn it, and clears about 3 seconds later.
ntrvlx goes immediately to the right and adds a weight knob and a snap switch over the stacking, plus a trigger output for each sequence.
menu: Range: -1v...1v, -2v...2v, -3v...3v, -5v...5v — sets the voltage the step knobs span
